_meta.about: Loot decided by hand, next to data/loot_wiki.json. That file is generated (data/build_loot_wiki.py) from the wiki, which has no page for these creatures' drops, so their rows live here rather than in it. by_type is rolled by server/mobs.loot_table exactly like a loot_wiki.json row -- one roll per row, valuables first, at most mobs.MAX_DROPS kept -- and names its item by type id, since the linker ties the emerald and the ingot to no type at all; a row at chance mobs.SURE (1.0) is no roll but a certainty, and lies in the bag outside that cap (mobs.roll_table); a row's count says how many of the thing it puts there (mobs.count_of). items are the numbers of those items, laid over the designed frame by server/items.py the way data/heal_manual.json is (same keys, frame shape unchanged; a data/items_wiki.json record, should one appear, wins), and drop_on_death, which server/combat.drops_on_death reads here before the wiki. Keys starting with _ never reach the wire.
_meta.decided: 2026-09-25, owner («Песок и изумруды»): the Nubian mine's marauders, [1] Слабый Мародёр 836 and [2] Мародёр 837, drop gold sand and emeralds. They stand in the mine's files and nowhere else (612, 1011, 1217 and the unused copies 767, 1248; no spawn substitute maps to them), so nothing else in the world drops either. Chances DESIGNED: gold sand 0.50 from both (the owner raised it from 0.20/0.30 the same day: «подними шанс песка до 50%»), an ordinary row; the emerald 0.10 from both, a valuable one. 2026-09-26, owner («давай добавим лут шахтерам: бритву и наручные часы и еще сломанные часы, вероятность выпадения 20-30 процентов»): the same marauders also roll, as ordinary rows, Сломанные часы 6919 and Бритва 6926 at 0.30 and Наручные часы 6932 at 0.35 -- under mobs.MAX_DROPS about 0.28, 0.23 and 0.21 a kill. Then («давай еще золотой портсигар и золотой зуб») Золотой зуб 6950 and Золотой портсигар 6953 as valuables at 0.05 each. The sand and the emeralds fall off a dead player like any loot (the owner, 2026-09-25: «любой лут должен падать в том числе из шахты», against the game's hint that the mine's emeralds could not be lost), and the way out of the mine takes neither («Нет, пусть выносят»). 2026-09-25, owner («давай чтобы у босса в нубийке выпадал слиток золото и сделай квест, чтобы его можно было сдать и получить на баланс», then «и слиток в 5 голд»): the Nubian valley's one boss, [5] Лидер Новые колонисты 2103 (Лагерь бандитов, location 34, where it keeps the boss hours of server/bosses.py), carries one ingot of 5 ounces of gold (4796 New_Gold_Ingot_5) on every kill, chance 1.0, and Джеррах in the Западный поселок pays 5 ounces for it (data/quests.json 10). It falls off a dead player like any loot («любой лут должен падать»): it is loot, not gold-bought gear. 2026-09-26, for the Nubian valley's quests (the owner's «давай готовь квесты все»): rows of the tier «Квестовый», the wiki's own word, for what those quests send the player to take off a creature -- the courier's letter (17), the four gun parts and the medicaments off the raiders of «Грабители» (14, 15), the medicaments and the grindstone off the New Colonists (250, 251), the leader's notes (2103) and the rat king (1019). Such a row rolls only while somebody who brought the creature down has a quest open that asks for the thing and does not yet have as many as it asks (server/mobs.py QUEST_TIER, quests.wanted_things), the original's «loot only while the quest is open»: nobody else finds a quest's litter in a bag, and a thing with no price or with the quest flag, which no other row may drop, may drop here. Holders RECOVERED where the original's texts or the quests' lavabook records name them, chances DESIGNED. The same day, for the valley's market, farm and mine quests (the third batch): the old chip Доктор Гофус asks for off the New Colonists (250, 251), and the antelope's meat and fillet the village asks for off the antelopes (12). 2026-10-05, owner approved: matches 6915 are ordinary loot from colonists 250/251 at base chance 0.30, subject to MAX_DROPS. They drop without an active quest and beyond five boxes, matching the wiki trash-loot classification and allowing players to collect ahead of the daily quest. The quest pays 700 afro and a choice of three health or stamina consumables (data/quests.json 51). Cashing stays his 301-303, less the original's 0.05 an ingot. 2026-10-11, owner: «у всех лагерей сделай голды в 2 раза меньше и округли в меньшую сторону» -- every camp boss's gold halved, rounded down: колонисты 3 -> 1, Люшер 5 -> 2, джанджавиды 6 -> 3, Магриб 10 -> 5, the valley's Лидер 2103 5 -> 2; 2 and 3 ounces as one stack of the 1-ounce ingot (the owner's rule of 2026-10-09, «типа 3 по 1г слитку»), 5 as the one ingot of five. Там голду дают 6 (работорговцы) и 8 (живодеры), принимает также Мортимер в портовом рынке»): the four hour-keeping bosses of Абри's two camps carry their faction's gold on every kill, chance 1.0, outside the cap, as Вади-Хальфа's do: the slave traders (327 Папаша Абу, the camp 88; 328 Надзиратель Лаки, the chief's place 89) 6 ounces, one ingot of 5 and one of 1; the flayers (360 Элфрид, the camp 92; 361 Бетти, the chief's place 90) 8 ounces, one ingot of 5 and one stack of three of 1. Both bosses of a faction carry the faction's sum, as in Вади-Хальфа (its plan's decision 1 names the alternative, the sum a camp's: 3 and 4 a boss). Абри's two treasurers (590, 591) stand all day and carry none. A window of the boss hours now holds 24 + 28 = 52 ounces for the whole server, 156 a day (server/test_abri_ingots.py). Мортимер sells and cashes them in Абри's port market too (data/placements.json 187). 2026-10-13, owner («и потом сделай донголу тоже», Донгола the way Абри was made, then «делай как считаешь нужным»): the four hour-keeping bosses of Донгола's two camps carry their faction's gold on every kill, chance 1.0, outside the cap, as Абри's and Вади-Хальфа's do. The owner named no sums; the decision taken for him is the ladder's next rung -- Вади-Хальфа 1/2/3/5, Абри 6/8, Донгола 10/12: the ДСР (374 Полковник Халил, the camp 93; 375 Джибрил Ибрагим, the chief's place 91) 10 ounces, one ingot of ten; the Peacekeepers (407 Шеф Дженсен, the camp 98; 408 Макс Коул, the chief's place 99) 12 ounces, one ingot of ten and a stack of two of one. Both bosses of a faction carry the faction's sum, as before; the alternatives (10 and 12 a camp, 5 and 6 a boss; or 7/9) are rows of this table. The 10-ounce ingot drops again. Донгола's two treasurers (592, 593) stand all day and carry none, and the copy 1171 of the Peacekeepers' camp is out of the game (data/retired.json), so Дженсен stands in one place. A window of the boss hours now holds 52 + 44 = 96 ounces for the whole server (about 4.8 million afro at 50 000 an ounce), 288 a day -- a ceiling, reached only if every boss falls in every window. No new sink: gold leaves by the things and services sold for gold (Донгола adds the sets and weapons G of its band 12-16 and its gold lottery) and Мортимер's 0.05 an ingot at cashing, 0.40 for a window's eight ingots of Донгола. The owner named no sums; the decision taken for him is the ladder's next rung -- Вади-Хальфа 1/2/3/5, Абри 6/8, Донгола 10/12, Абу-Хамед 14/16 --, and the rule that every hour-keeping boss of the town's bank brings gold. The pirates (777 Коммодор Марабу, the camp 132; 778 Капитан Нгоро, the chief's place 133) 14 ounces, one ingot of ten and a stack of four of one. The alternatives (the outpost's Шерхан without gold; 7 and 8 a boss; 15 and 20) are rows of this table. Абу-Хамед's treasurers (764, 1024) and book-keeper (1736) stand all day and carry none; the pirates' «[17] Кавторанг» (771), a boss by his type's word that stood in 133 by its file, is a rank and file fighter since (data/build_mob_types.py DESIGNED_KINDS) and carries none. A window of the boss hours now holds 96 + 74 = 170 ounces for the whole server (about 8.5 million afro at 50 000 an ounce), 510 a day -- a ceiling, reached only if every boss falls in every window. The window's 21 ingots of Абу-Хамед cost 1.05 ounces at Мортимер's cashing. Мортимер stands in Абу-Хамед's port 446 by the original's file (server/test_abuhamed_ingots.py). _meta.fields: by_type: mob type id -> rows {type, tier ('Обычный' or 'Ценный', as in loot_wiki.json, or 'Квестовый': rolled only for a quest that asks for the thing, on its own and outside the cap), chance; 1.0 is certain and outside the cap; count, how many of the thing the row puts in the bag when it lies there, 1 without one (mobs.count_of: a stack of that many); or, in place of tier and chance, one_of (a group name) and weight: exactly one row of the group lies in the bag on every kill, picked by weight, outside the cap (mobs.one_of_groups)}. items: type id -> ss_si_simple_obj fields as in server/items.py (cost in afro, g_cost in hundredths of G, weight in grams, max_count the most one stack holds), plus drop_on_death (1 can fall off a corpse, 0 never).

4796._source: RECOVERED. The type: texts.xml 7636-7641 are the three gold ingots of 1, 5 and 10 ounces, name and description each, and objects.xml's New_Gold_Ingot_1/_5/_10 (7620, 4796, 4797) are the one series of three with icons stamped 1, 5 and 10; the older Gold_Ingot_5 (3562) draws a lollipop in the client (data/build_orig_items.py rule 7d, data/orig_items.json). Numbers: the wiki article 5 унций золота (its icon 5.png is named after no type, so the linker tied it to none and data/items_wiki.json has no record): 'Вес 5 г', 'Допустимость обмена Да', 'Допустимость продажи Да', 'Базовая цена 5 G'; sold by Мортимер, the money-changer, and cashed in by his 'Обналичить 5 унций' for 5 ounces. drop_on_death 1: loot, the owner's rule («любой лут должен падать»; «голдовое оружие и сэты не падают» is about gold-bought gear, «это не лут»)
4796._designed: the prices: the article's 5 G as g_cost 500, for which Мортимер sells it at face value (data/npcs.json 1188, the owner's of 2026-10-09: «добавь в черный рынок мортимера который обменивает слитки ... и продает их еще»), and the same 5 ounces in afro at the game's one rate, 250 000 at 50 000; both laid by server/items.py GOLD_INGOTS from progression.GOLD_TO_AFRO_RATE, which wins over the figures here should the rate move. The afro price keeps the ingot loot: mobs.droppable lets nothing without one into a corpse's bag, and a thing priced in gold alone is one of the owner's gold things (combat.gold_item), which never fall off a body; combat.gold_item answers no for every ingot. The shipped client buys a thing with a g_cost for gold (Trade.buy), and inventory.Inventory.buy refuses an ingot for afro, which would turn afro into gold. A trader pays 70 per cent of the afro price (inventory.SMOD), 175 000 afro, less than c_ga's 250 000 for the same 5 ounces; Мортимер's cashing pays 4.95, never more than the ingot costs at his stall. The Maghreb's bosses drop it (by_type 313, 314) since 2026-10-11, Абри's four (327, 328, 360, 361) since 2026-10-12, and Абу-Хамед's base's two (1037, 1038) since 2026-10-14; the valley's 2103 dropped it from 2026-09-25 until then, for Джеррах's quest 10. Until 2026-10-09 it had no g_cost and no stall sold it. The stack of 50 is the frame's: the article gives none
